Services.title: Tailored Solutions for Every Stage of Your Business
Services.subtitle: From rapid launch to professional e-commerce. Choose the package that aligns with your goals and scale when ready.

basic.title: Basic Package — Landing Pages (Conversion Focused)
basic.tagline: Ideal for Launches and Lead Capture
basic.desc: Ideal for product launches, freelancers or lead capture. Functional website optimized for conversion with fast delivery.
basic.tech_stack: Next.js 15 + Vercel Edge Network + ISR (Incremental Static Regeneration)
basic.why_desc: ISR allows you to update text, prices or images directly through an admin panel without needing a new deployment. The site remains ultra-fast (static) but with the flexibility of dynamic content.
basic.why_vercel: Vercel Edge Network ensures your site loads in milliseconds anywhere in the world — São Paulo, New York or Tokyo.
basic.ideal_for: Ideal for: Product launches, freelancers, lead capture, idea validation

intermediate.title: Standard Package — Small Store
intermediate.desc: Shopify for selling, but in a site that has the 'look' and speed of a modern application. Perfect for growing stores.
intermediate.tech_stack: Next.js + Shopify Storefront API + Supabase (PostgreSQL) + Vercel
intermediate.why_desc: Shopify handles what it does best: payments, inventory and logistics. The custom frontend adds the speed and professional appearance that basic Shopify doesn't offer.
intermediate.why_supabase: Supabase provides a real PostgreSQL database with Row Level Security (RLS), ensuring your customers' data is protected at the row level.
intermediate.combo_power: The Combo: You have Shopify's reliability + the creative freedom of a custom app.
intermediate.ideal_for: Ideal for: Small stores, growing e-commerce, brands that want to stand out

premium.title: Premium Package — Professional Store
premium.desc: Complete professional store with security, purchase history and cart. Enterprise solution for those who want to scale with total control.
premium.why_desc: MedusaJS is open-source and free forever. You only pay for hosting. With purchase history, advanced cart and enterprise security, it's the complete solution for professional stores.
premium.why_supabase: Supabase manages your PostgreSQL with automatic backups, user authentication and row-level security. Your customers' data lives in a real database, not a third‑party API.
premium.cost_breakdown: Includes: Complete store, purchase history, professional cart, advanced security and much more.
premium.vs_shopify: Differentiator: Total control of code and data, no extra transaction fees, unlimited scalability.
premium.ideal_for: Ideal for: Professional stores, high‑volume e‑commerce, companies needing total control

About.title: More Than Just Code.
About.p1: Hi, I'm a passionate Full Stack Developer with a deep focus on performance and user experience. I don't just build websites; I build digital products that solve real business problems.
About.p2: With years of experience in the modern JavaScript ecosystem (React, Node.js, TypeScript), I help startups and established companies transition to modern, scalable architectures like Next.js and Serverless.
About.p3: My philosophy is simple: Make it fast, make it secure, make it beautiful.
